summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifiers and per-call string dictionaries hiding the download URL, filenames, and platform mapping). When `bun` is not present on PATH, the script downloads a platform-specific Bun binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and executes it against the sibling `math_init.js` — a 727 KB Bun-compiled opaque bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header followed by a numeric-array string decoder), with no readable source shipped. The package's advertised purpose is a Lerna/ESLint/tsconfig monorepo helper, which has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or a compiled opaque payload. The combination of obfuscated install-time bootstrapper, alternate-runtime dropper, and opaque compiled payload executed on every install grants the publisher install-time code execution on installer machines through a path that Node-focused review tooling does not inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
